messages:
deploy-bot: [deploy] starting canary deploy: payments-service chart=payments-chart v3.2.0 -> eu-west-1 (canary)
ryan: preflight failed: values validation
ryan: ```
Error: values.schema: payments.redis.pool.size: expected integer, got "small"
  at /charts/payments/values.yaml:72
```
sasha: saw liveness spikes in canary pods, SIGTERM restarts, not OOM
jen: if this is a values schema regression we should avoid promoting. options: pin back to v3.1.9, or hotpatch 3.2.0 with corrected values schema
sam: quick context — change window ends 23:00 UTC, but infra blackout at 22:30 for backups
tess: prefer pin -> rollback canary, because hotpatch touches templates and risk is higher
ryan: helm commands to roll back/pin:
ryan: ```
# rollback to previous release
helm rollback payments-service 42 --namespace prod-eu
# or patch chart version pin in release repo
sed -i 's/3.2.0/3.1.9/' releases/eu/payments/manifest.yaml && git commit -m "pin payments to 3.1.9 after canary fail" && ./ci/promote-release
```
jen: who will approve the pin? @sasha or @ryan pls
sasha: +1 approving pin, will follow up with release notes update
deploy-bot: Pin request queued: /deploy pin payments-chart v3.1.9 by sasha — awaiting operator execution
ryan: I'll run post-pin smoke tests and update release notes: reverted chart to v3.1.9, mention schema regression and link to PR #1234
tess: add a follow-up ticket to run value-schema lints in preflight CI
deploy-bot: Canary aborted for v3.2.0 — rollback initiated to 3.1.9. Operators: @ryan monitoring. :white_check_mark:
